svg.title: The gated MLP: x splits into gate_proj and up_proj, GELU squeezes the gate, the two are multiplied column by column so small gates close their taps, and down_proj brings the product back to 2048

g.text: gates of −0.05 and 0.00 close their taps, a gate of 2.38 lets its number through, scaled up
6 of 16,384 middle numbers shown, values chosen for the example
three linear layers: up decides what flows, the gate decides how much
